name: Towashi
description: Towashi, also called Dragon's Well, is a neon-lit city of Kamigawa that hosts the Lantern Festival and the Undercity, and lies below Otawara.

timeline.summary: Towashi's growth consumed the edges of Jukai and enclosed the grove of Boseiju, displacing forest kami.
timeline.quote: As Towashi's boundaries stretched outward, the city began encroaching upon the ancient Jukai Forest, gradually consuming its edges.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The angered kami attacked, demolishing new structures and cursing those responsible.
timeline.quote: the kami unleashed their wrath by demolishing recently built structures and casting curses upon those responsible for the desecration.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor brokered an agreement: Towashi would stop growing into the forest, Boseiju could not be cut down, and Jukai closed to mortals without the kami's permission.
timeline.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The construction of Towashi destroys forest and enrages the kami, who close Jukai Forest to everyone including the orochi.
timeline.quote: They drove out all who had been living within its borders and closed the forest off to everyone — including the Orochi.

citation.text: "Snake", section "Orochi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towashi's expansion into Jukai Forest angers the kami, who retaliate.
timeline.quote: rose from the forest depths to retaliate

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor brokers an agreement halting growth into the forest and forbidding cutting Boseiju.
timeline.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towashi grows upward and Boseiju is lost in the skyline.
timeline.quote: Towashi was forced to grow upwards instead

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Boseiju grows again until it eclipses every structure.
timeline.quote: began to grow once again

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo leads the Phyrexian assault and corrupts and bursts Boseiju.
timeline.quote: The tree itself was corrupted by Tamiyo

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito stalks a gambler through the crowded Lantern Festival for a Reckoner job.
timeline.quote: It hadn't taken Kaito long to find his target.

timeline.summary: Kaito reflects that it has been a year since the emperor went missing, the night he chased a stranger out of Kyodai's temple.
timeline.quote: It had only been a year since the emperor went missing.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito picks the gambler's pocket and clears the job on his comm.
timeline.quote: Kaito reached into the man's coat and retrieved his wallet.

citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito, now a planeswalker, returns to Towashi in his mask, resolved to keep searching the Multiverse for the emperor.
timeline.quote: There were many more planes to search.

citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito, now a planeswalker, scouts Towashi with his tanuki drone Himoto and spots Imperial samurai outside an apartment with a window left ajar.
timeline.quote: Kaito nudged the drone skyward toward the height of the nearby buildings.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.quote: turning to face his sister

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Eiko explains Risona's supporters and the Asari Uprisers grow bolder as the throne stays empty.
timeline.quote: The Asari Uprisers grow bolder every day.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Eiko argue over technology and balance, Kaito insisting technology levels the playing field.
timeline.quote: Technology levels the playing field.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Using a noise suppressor, Eiko tells Kaito that Tameshi was seen meeting a man with a metal arm in the Undercity.
timeline.quote: Tameshi was seen meeting with a man in the Undercity. A man with a metal arm.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito decides to trust his sister enough to investigate and spy on his best friend.
timeline.quote: Kaito believed in his sister enough to follow the trail.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The builders of Towashi razed the forest but left Boseiju unscathed.
timeline.quote: Though they razed the surrounding forest, the builders of Towashi left Boseiju unscathed, shaping the city around the ancient tree.

citation.text: Branch of Boseiju (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Clear-cutting for Towashi made Jukai Forest hostile to outsiders.
timeline.quote: After large sections were clear-cut to build Towashi, the once-peaceful Jukai Forest grew violently hostile to outsiders.

citation.text: Invoke the Ancients (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: An ancient kami awakens beneath the city as pavement rips.
timeline.quote: Pavement ripped like paper as the ancient kami awoke from her long slumber beneath the city.

citation.text: Season of Renewal (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: About 1200 years after the Kami War, the kami are threatened by the growth of Towashi.
timeline.quote: About 1200 years after the Kami War the kami are threatened by the growth of the modern city of Towashi.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret travels across planes already overrun by Phyrexians, finding Baltrice's safehouses compromised.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn's "great work" was unfolding faster than Tezzeret could have imagined.

timeline.summary: Nashi shoots Tezzeret in Towashi's undercity and demands to know where Tamiyo is.
timeline.quote: Tell me where she is.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret turns on Nashi's gang and crushes their motorbikes.
timeline.quote: lifting the bikes into the air and then slamming them together with a gruesome crunch

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells the wounded Nashi that his mother still lives and will come for him.
timeline.quote: Your mother still lives.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret finds Baltrice's safehouse behind a gaming parlor and gathers supplies.
timeline.quote: Inside, he found exactly what he was looking for.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo hovers over Towashi, removing the iron ring from the scroll she wrote and reading it as the Phyrexian assault begins.
timeline.quote: Hovering over the neon skies of Towashi, she holds the scroll in hand.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reads the story of Urza, Karn and Memnarch, and her words shake Towashi, collapsing buildings and etching Phyrexian symbols.
timeline.quote: Each syllable she reads booms and reverberates, shaking the skyscrapers of Towashi.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The scroll turns to oil in Tamiyo's hands as the story ends with Phyrexia's victory.
timeline.quote: This is how the story ends, and how it has always ended: with Phyrexia's victory.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya helps Kaito defend Kamigawa and phases through a wall to find a trapped boy and his dog.
timeline.quote: A young boy and his dog quiver in the corner on the other side.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya pulls the boy and dog free and leaps with them from a collapsing building, but the balcony falls away.
timeline.quote: Kaya, the boy, and the dog plummet.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito saves Kaya and the boy by slowing their fall with telekinesis.
timeline.quote: His telekinesis is barely holding them up

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Imperial forces with giant mechs gather to counter the Phyrexian assault as Kaito reflects that Tamiyo fell but Nashi lived.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo fell—but Nashi lived.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Towashi's expansion into Jukai Forest drove out kami, who attacked the new buildings.
timeline.quote: Enraged, the kami fought back, emerging from the depths of the forest to wreck the newly constructed buildings

citation.text: "Boseiju", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor brokered an agreement halting Towashi's growth into the forest and forbidding the felling of Boseiju.
timeline.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

citation.text: "Boseiju", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Boseiju began to grow again until it eclipsed the city's tallest structures.
timeline.quote: It grew so large and so tall that it came to eclipse even the tallest structures surrounding it.

citation.text: "Boseiju", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A young monk displaced by Towashi builds a shrine around a seed that becomes the Kami of Boundless Vigor and reclaims a section of forest.
timeline.quote: Together, the kami and monk reclaimed his section of the forest.

citation.text: "Go-Shintai of Boundless Vigor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito discovers Tameshi was secretly working with Jin-Gitaxias, who kills Tameshi after getting what he needed.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias killed Tameshi.

citation.text: "Tameshi", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: He raises a corpse-swallower toad from the Towashi canal and becomes the Toad Rider.
timeline.quote: Tatsunari hopped on its back and became the Toad Rider

citation.text: "Tatsunari", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
